The Night Before
Xcel Energy Center, Saint Paul, MN

Taper: Mike Peters (<email>)
Location: Center Ice, Right Stack ~ 14ft (A-B configuration)
Source: AKG CK61-ULS Caps (Active Cables) > Naiant Midbox > Sony PCM-10 (24/96 LPCM)
Conversion: Samsung Pro 64GB SD Card > USB 3.0 > Sound Forge Pro 11 (Normalize to -0.01dB, iZotope 64-bit SRC resample, iZotope MBIT+ 16-bit advanced light dither) > CD Wave Editor (Track Splits) > Foobar2000 (Tagging)

*** A 24-bit 96kHz version of this source is also available ***
